title: Big English 2 Student Book — Units 1–9 Book Intelligence (v2 eight-column)
notes: Experimental Phase 2 interpretation ported from approved BE2 v2 eight-column Markdown overview. Content is a faithful cell-level copy (markdown emphasis markers removed). Not Phase 1 evidence; not merged into canonical/v1.json; format not locked. No Writing column. Source Markdown: docs/phase-2/experiments/be2-sb-u01-u09-book-overview-d017-v2.md. Contract: docs/phase-2/book-intelligence-ui-data-contract-v1.md.

units.title: In My Classroom
units.vocabulary: Classroom actions (coloring, counting, cutting, using the computer…)
units.grammar_structures: Present continuous Q&A; How many / There is/are; imperatives; May I…? / Let's take turns
units.communicative_functions: Ask/describe current actions; count classroom items; give rules; ask permission / take turns
units.learning_outcomes: Talk about what people are doing in class; count (incl. to 100 / simple arithmetic); talk about taking turns
units.clil_culture: Math: numbers 11–100, plus/minus/equals; Culture: outdoor/unusual classes

units.title: My Games
units.grammar_structures: like/love + -ing; like/love to; Me, too! / Me neither!; safety imperatives with always
units.communicative_functions: Talk about activity preferences; agree/disagree with likes; give playground safety instructions
units.learning_outcomes: Say what people like doing/to do; talk about how the body works (bones/muscles); talk about playing safely
units.clil_culture: Science: bones & muscles; Culture: traditional games

units.title: In My House
units.vocabulary: Furniture & rooms; prepositions (between, behind, next to…); family (aunt, uncle, cousin)
units.grammar_structures: Where's / Where are…?; prepositions of place; possessive 's; possessive pronouns (mine, yours…)
units.communicative_functions: Locate objects/rooms; talk about whose things are where; contrast preferences with possessives
units.learning_outcomes: Say where things are; talk about possessions; talk about old and new objects
units.clil_culture: History: old/new museum objects; Culture: household objects worldwide

units.title: In My Town
units.vocabulary: Town places (restaurant, post office, mall…); buy, send; money (dollar, cent)
units.grammar_structures: want(s) to; Is there…?; street location; How do you go…? by…; How much is/are…?; First…
units.communicative_functions: Give locations; express wants; ask if a place exists; talk about transport and prices; describe safe crossing
units.learning_outcomes: Say what I want and talk about money; describe where places are; talk about kinds of transportation

units.title: My Dream Job
units.grammar_structures: What do you/does he want to be?; job duties with do; because; look + adjective; I like… / I want to be…
units.communicative_functions: Talk about career hopes; describe what jobs do; give reasons; check how someone looks/feels
units.learning_outcomes: Talk about jobs; say what I want to be and why; talk about studying hard and setting goals
units.clil_culture: Social science: goods & services; Culture: youth ambitions

units.title: My Day
units.vocabulary: Clock times (one–twelve o'clock); routine verbs (get up, go to bed, start/finish school…)
units.grammar_structures: What time is it?; When do/does…? at…; schedule start/finish; wh- words (who/what/when/where/how…)
units.communicative_functions: Tell the time; ask/talk about daily routines and schedules; ask open personal questions
units.learning_outcomes: Talk about times and daily activities; ask questions; talk about different ways of telling time
units.clil_culture: History: sundial, candle, hourglass, water clock; Culture: school-day routines abroad

units.title: My Favorite Food
units.vocabulary: Foods (bananas, yogurt, sandwiches…); nutrition words (healthy, sugar, salt…)
units.grammar_structures: Do/Does … like…?; countable/uncountable with a/an/some; offers (Do you want some/a…?); polite request/decline
units.communicative_functions: Talk about food likes; specify quantity; offer/accept/decline food; choose healthier options
units.learning_outcomes: Talk about food; talk about healthy/unhealthy food; say where fruit comes from
units.clil_culture: Science: healthy/unhealthy snacks; Culture: fruit origins

units.title: Wild Animals
units.vocabulary: Zoo/wild animals (giraffe, cheetah, crocodile…); habitat words (desert, ocean, jungle, forest…); chase
units.grammar_structures: Modal can/can't (ability); adjective order; They're so + adj
units.communicative_functions: State animal abilities; ask yes/no ability questions; describe animals with ordered adjectives; express appreciation
units.learning_outcomes: Describe animals; talk about where animals live; talk about appreciating animals
units.clil_culture: Science: animal habitats; Culture: animals near home

units.title: Fun All Year
units.vocabulary: Months; seasons; weather (hot, sunny, snowing…); festival words; always/never
units.grammar_structures: Favorite month; always/never + present simple; When do you celebrate…?; What's the weather like?
units.communicative_functions: Talk about months and habits; place holidays in seasons; describe weather
units.learning_outcomes: Talk about what I do each month; talk about the weather; talk about seasonal holidays
units.clil_culture: Geography: seasonal festivals; Culture: New Year traditions
